column1: # mid_run_gives_baseline.tsv -- the mid-run `::give` literals committed quest
# tests carried when lint_quest.py's check_mid_run_gives landed (2026-10-03).
# matthew-mbp-m4-b56 458d31771 and origin/v3 a8974744e: the same 113 literals
# on 98 lines in 23 files. A give listed here is BASELINED -- printed and
# counted, not refused -- until the orchestrator decides it: move it into
# setup, drive the item the way the guide does, or mark the line
# `-- lint: kit-give <reason>` (then delete or lower its row here). Rows are
# keyed by test and the exact cheat literal (`"::give " .. item` is "::give"),
# with a count, not a line number; `lines` is where they sat at the measure.
# The list only shrinks: a row whose give is gone is a lint finding.
